Netanyahu Rejects US-Backed Gaza Peace Plan, Citing Disarmament Conditions

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated he did not agree to a US-backed peace plan for Gaza, asserting that Israeli troops would not withdraw until Hamas is completely disarmed. This comes as US President Donald Trump has been touting a peace initiative and reportedly expressed disappointment if Israel did not agree. Reports indicate Trump's team presented the plan, which involves talks with Hamas. Meanwhile, Israeli strikes in Gaza have resulted in casualties, with one report stating 19 deaths.
